details.detail: Sidewall panels and seams. Smooth satin off-white with a seam mid-pier after every second window. No cracks, gaps or z-fighting on the wall run (win_front, win_close, s09, s02). The dead `2.02` branch in the upper-sidewall loop is gone (y1 = 2.0). The blue upper wash belongs to LIGHTING and is not scored.

F/J recess (REC, ext 0.045). The recess top now has a clearly shaded roll: in win_close at column 220 it reads 155-160 against a wall of 220-224 (0.72), a band about 16 px deep, and s09 and s05 show the grey top arc. The tub face below that roll still reads at wall level (220-224), so the 'bowl' is a shaded lip rather than a graded face. That is much closer to f_17313 / Room-24 than w3 was. A faint light wedge remains on the rolled opening lip at its upper-right corner (win_close 2x crop, about x 490-510, y 440-470 of the crop).

PY/Y tub (REC_Y, ext 0.055). The width, the top at the bin line and the lower bowl are all good, and the top arc now shades (s01, s08, s03). The opening is still centred in the tub. That depends on the open pane-centre question and is not scored against the owner.

Pane seal rim and lining. The rim is lighter and thinner and reads as a fine grey-blue outline round the glass (s05, s09, s03), which matches the ml/ close-ups. The lining tunnel is clean, with no gaps.

F/J electric shades and button. The sheer edges are now clean: the hems taper flat and the round corners are masked, so the s05 3x crop shows no serration (FIXED). The blackout is still 0.73 of the bezel (171,164,152 against 233,232,230; the photo is 0.62-0.64). Moire is reduced: the win_oblique crop now shows only mild banding. In win_front a column through the blackout still beats, with valley/crest amplitude swinging from about +/-5 to +/-35 over about 20 px. The pill button is fine.
PY/Y manual shade. The cream grip band and the half and closed states are correct (win_front, s08).

Dado, grilles and placards. The field is lighter. Grille against dado is 0.60 in s04 (#2b2e35 against #454a56) and 0.65 in the studio, against 0.70 in py_37303 (#2d3744 against #3e4b5f), so it is nearly there. The 7 vertical ribs are still plainly visible as light bars in win_low and win_oblique; py_37303 shows horizontal louvres only. The 100 mm placards between the grilles match py_37303's small white label. The in-cabin dado is a little less blue than the photo's #3e4b5f.

Carpets, vinyl and track covers. The F carpet is still a warm brown-grey (q02) against f_17300. The galley vinyl is fine (s06, s07). The Y/PY navy carpet with its royal-blue track covers is fine (s04, q16).

Type A door surround and viewing window. The lining is now warm cream at the lower door (s06, s07) and the seams are light. The window has its tunnel and seal. There is still no glass: the door-2 window is a flat (231,236,241) card. The door-4 view shows the exterior, but untinted. The window is centred on the door (see Rater A and the open door question). The lining furniture belongs to 10_mono and is flagged only.
